svg.title: whoami — Prem Arvinth G
svg.desc: A neofetch-style card. On the left, an ASCII-art portrait of Prem being scanned by a face detector. On the right: Full-Stack .NET Developer at Russell Tobin since August 2026, Chennai. Frontend Angular, TypeScript, React, Bootstrap. Backend C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core, LINQ. Databases SQL Server, T-SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL. Data Power BI, DAX, Pandas. Hardware ESP32, Embedded C, OpenCV, YOLOv8. B.E. ECE, Anna University, 2026. Hackathon winner, IEEE-format paper.
